StackType.issue: PowerStackType.Single, and the sim overrides on_stack to `pass` citing it. Per the settled census (`py audit/tools/power_census.py stack`, 15 such units) that reasoning is wrong: Single means "Amount is hidden and is always 1" (PowerStackType.cs:10-13), and PowerCmd.ModifyAmount (PowerCmd.cs:236) adds unconditionally with no StackType branch -- so C# really does reach Amount 2 on a second application while the sim stays at 1. Dormant because nothing reads Nemesis's Amount -- the alternation is driven by the private `_should_apply` bool (powers.py:3428, mirroring C#'s `_shouldApplyIntangible` at NemesisPower.cs:14) and not by Amount -- and because the only ported applier, monsters/glory/test_subject.py:139, applies it exactly once at the phase-3 transition. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.rationale: Correct slot (Hook.AfterTurnEnd, Hook.cs:1267, CombatManager.cs:1256 -> on_enemy_side_end, combat.py:345). The alternation, the Intangible 1 grant and the removal on the off-beat all match NemesisPower.cs:20-35, `HasPower<IntangiblePower>` test included (powers.py:3441). Note the removal mid-dispatch: hook_dispatch gap G7's ONLY whole-suite hit is exactly this pair -- on_enemy_side_end -> IntangiblePower x10, Nemesis removing Intangible while the dispatch walks -- and G7 records that C# makes the same call, because the PowerModel arm of CombatState.Contains (CombatState.cs:599) checks only `Owner.CombatState != null` and never that the power is still on its owner. Faithful by that already-executed cross-reference. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.issue: Replaced by `if self.owner.is_dead: return` (powers.py:3435) -- the same substitution as HighVoltage's and Territorial's, and one degree worse here, because the sim's early return also SKIPS THE TOGGLE (`_should_apply` is not flipped), so a Nemesis owner that is dead for one side end and alive for the next resumes on the wrong beat where C# would have flipped. DORMANT: the Test Subject's phase-3 Nemesis owner is the boss itself and a dead boss ends the combat (monsters/glory/test_subject.py), so no side end ever finds it dead-but-present. Trigger: Nemesis on a creature with ShouldStopCombatFromEnding or ShouldCreatureBeRemovedFromCombatAfterDeath -- i.e. an Illusion / Reattach / Adaptable / Infested / Steam Eruption / Stock / Surprise holder, all of which are ported.

guards.rationale: Closed game-wide, re-verified 2026-07-26. EXECUTED: `py audit/tools/power_census.py visible` reports 0 IsVisibleInternal overrides of 260 files. That 260 is the .cs files DIRECTLY under src/Core/Models/Powers and EXCLUDES the 16 in Powers/Mocks/ (276 including them); a recursive `grep -rn IsVisibleInternal src/Core/Models/Powers/`, which does cover Mocks/, also returns 0 -- so IsVisible is provably always true for every power in the decompiled game, mocks included. CITATION FIX (2026-07-26 review fix pass): the property lives in src/Core/Models/PowerModel.cs, NOT under Models/Powers/ -- `IsVisible` is the non-virtual property at PowerModel.cs:150-160 and the overridable virtual is `IsVisibleInternal` at PowerModel.cs:167.
